scope: Abraj Al Bait Clock Tower, Mecca (schematic)
title: Abraj Al Bait
blurb: The 601 m Makkah Royal Clock Tower, centerpiece of the seven-tower Abraj Al Bait complex facing the Masjid al-Haram: the largest clock faces in the world at 43 m across, crowned by a 23 m golden crescent.

sourceUrls.label: arabmls.org: Abraj Al Bait Royal Clock Tower

systems.name: Podium and prayer hall
systems.description: The seven-storey podium with the shopping mall, entrances, roof terrace and the prayer hall for about 4,000 worshippers.

systems.name: Tower shaft
systems.description: The central tower shaft in setback tiers from the podium to the clock section, with glass curtain walls and corner piers.

systems.name: Clock and crescent crown
systems.description: The four 43 m clock faces, their golden surrounds and corner pillars, the LED and calligraphy bands.

systems.name: Spire
systems.description: The 93 m needle above the clock with the lunar observation deck and the 23 m golden crescent, the largest in the world.

systems.name: Flanking towers
systems.description: The six hotel and residential towers of the complex: Hajar, Zamzam, Maqam, Qibla, Safa and Marwa.
